item.title: Govt fires starting gun on Lancs governance consultation
item.description: Residents across Lancashire’s 14 boroughs have until 26 March to contribute to the discussion about how the county will be carved up as part of Labour’s efforts to overhaul local governance. The post Govt fires starting gun on Lancs governance consultation appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Funds released for Manchester underground transport study
item.description: Those travelling on the Metrolink between Altrincham and Bury could be heading underground in the future, with Greater Manchester Combined Authority agreeing to invest £375,000 to begin feasibility studies on a tunnelled metro. The post Funds released for Manchester underground transport study appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Irwell Valley Homes makes office switch
item.description: The housing association has signed a 5,500 sq ft deal at Oaklands House in Sale, moving from the Soapworks in Salford Quays. The post Irwell Valley Homes makes office switch appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Sefton moves Southport Pier revamp along but wait for £20m grant drags on
item.description: AE Yates will carry out a £300,000 package of design and survey works as efforts to bring the country’s second longest pier back into use for the first time since December 2022 ramp up. The post Sefton moves Southport Pier revamp along but wait for £20m grant drags on appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Muse consults on changes to £100m Prestwich regen
item.description: More homes, a larger library, and a more generous public square are proposed as part of the redevelopment of the Longfield Centre. The post Muse consults on changes to £100m Prestwich regen appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Northwood resurrects Flint factory
item.description: The tissue manufacturer has acquired the 98-acre Kimberly-Clark production site off Aber Road, which had shuttered last year because of an upcoming UK ban of plastic-containing baby wipes. The post Northwood resurrects Flint factory appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Manchester approves pub redevelopment plan
item.description: Watson Homes has been given the go-ahead to build 35 apartments on the site of The Park in Northern Moor. The post Manchester approves pub redevelopment plan appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: MMU unveils plans for £20m student welcome building
item.description: Part of the former All Saints Library will be retained and converted to create a 30,000 sq ft adaptable multi-use facility under plans lodged by the university with Manchester City Council. The post MMU unveils plans for £20m student welcome building appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Blackburn agrees land swap with Issa Brothers’ development company
item.description: Monte Blackburn will take control of a site off Haslingden Road to develop a 10,000 sq ft retail scheme in exchange for a plot of land in the town centre that could prove useful for the council’s regeneration plans. The post Blackburn agrees land swap with Issa Brothers’ development company appeared first on Place North West.
